description: This Java class 'ImportServiceDelegate' acts as a delegate for importing books from external sources like LibraryThing and Goodreads within a book tracking application. It uses dependency injection to reference import services and provides methods to initiate import processes.

classes.name: ImportServiceDelegate
classes.description: A Spring service class that delegates book import operations from external sources.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Imports books from LibraryThing using the provided data import object.

methods.name: importFromGoodreads
methods.description: Initiates import of books from Goodreads; currently a placeholder with a TODO comment.
